preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and queries q are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(parents) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p <= n for p in parents)
preconditions.description: The parents list contains exactly n-1 integers, each representing a valid parent index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query node index is a valid node index between 1 and n.
The input parents define a valid tree rooted at node 1 (guaranteed by problem statement).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= n for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a valid node index between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(is_centroid(subtree_nodes(v), adj, int(output_lines[i]), subtree_size(v)) for i, v in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query node v, the output node c is a centroid of the subtree rooted at v. A node c is a centroid if, when removed from the subtree, the size of every resulting connected component is at most half the size of the subtree.
